The schematic is not scaled for measurements.

summit-fs10-port-seals.title: Summit Industries 2006 mobile A/C catalog: FS10 port seals and size 211 dimensions

Page 131 specifies nominal size 211 inside diameter .796 inch and section .139 inch, with tolerances .010 and .004 inch respectively. Shipping pad, plate and its bolt are not an installed vehicle manifold. Family comparison does not identify the truck's installed seal, gland dimensions, elastomer or manifold casting. No dimensions are scaled from illustrations.

uac-fs10-rear-port-photo.title: UAC CO101220C application-linked rear port photograph

Replacement application and port orientation comparison only, not installed-unit identity. Low-resolution perspective image does not establish port pitch, diameter, manifold outline or mounting coordinates.

nsk-fs10-clutch-bearing.title: NSK Magnetic Clutch Bearings for A/C Compressor

Installed bearing brand/suffix, ball count, ball diameter, pitch circles, contact angle, raceway sections, cage count/shape, seal profiles and fit tolerances.

nachi-magnetic-clutch-bearing-constructi.title: NACHI BG Type for Car Air Conditioning Magnetic Clutch, NAB0302-3

Performance test claims are not modeled and do not establish truck-specific loads.
